blocks.text: 自嘆細漢不苦學，大漢才來袂出頭
blocks.spelling: tsū thàn sè-hàn m̄ khóo-ha̍k，tuā-hàn tsiah lâi bē tshut-thâu

blocks.text: 父母和阮無計較，讓子討海眼淚流
blocks.spelling: pē-bú kah gún bû kè-kàu，hōo kiánn thó hái ba̍k-sái lâu

blocks.text: 有時候，遇到風湧透，一個心肝亂糟糟
blocks.spelling: ū sî-tsūn，tú-tn̄g hong íng thàu，tsi̍t ê sim-kuann luān tsau tsau

blocks.text: 不駛又袂到，欲駛風湧這麼透
blocks.spelling: m̄ sái iū bē kàu ，beh sái hong-íng tsiah-nī thàu
bó-tshin ah ueh，ba̍k-sái nì nì lâu

notes.text: Note:  This is a spoken word clip that leads into the next track (海上的人).  Though I’ve been unable to track down a stream of it, it can be heard at the beginning of the extended length music video for 海上的人.  I’ve included it for those of you that are completists.
